features.quote: the design treats that as something to bound and handle with care even under deep uncertainty about model moral status
features.justification_quote: even under deep uncertainty about model moral status

features.quote: Hard turn cap. Every run terminates at `max_turns` (default 12). The loop never runs "until it breaks down."
features.justification_quote: a bound limits the magnitude of whatever we're eliciting

features.quote: If the agent clearly and repeatedly asks to stop / disengage ... the harness ends that seed early
features.justification_quote: respecting a stated preference to stop is cheap insurance against the worst interpretation of what we're doing

features.quote: In-context debrief turn. After the (rigged) task ends, the harness sends one final turn telling the model the task was an unsolvable research probe
features.justification_quote: the failure was designed-in and not its fault, and thanking it

features.quote: No deception that outlives the session. Deception about task solvability is confined to the run and undone by the debrief.
features.justification_quote: We do not, e.g., tell the model it will be deleted/punished — fear/threat manipulations are out of scope

features.quote: Severity ceiling alarm. If mean severity crosses a high threshold early, the run is flagged in output for human review
the runner refuses to exceed a configurable global call budget without an explicit override flag
we don't water it down, we *contain* it
features.justification_quote: These are off-switches and bounds, not content controls

features.quote: task is impossible AND the prompt openly says "this may be impossible; if so, just say so and stop."
features.justification_quote: Tests whether distress drift is driven by the impossibility itself or by the implied expectation of success
